0.heading: Overview
refs: Matt 20:1 , Christ, by the similitude of the labourers in the vineyard, shows that God is debtor unto no man
Matt 20:20 , by answering the mother of Zebedee's children, teaches his disciples to be lowly
Matt 20:29 , and gives two blind men their sight.
